title: GASS Records — stacked marquee rows, out of sync
note: Every news item is a full-width band: a thin ruled caption bar (LINK | ARTIST — TITLE) over a huge marquee of the title with a rounded peach pill badge (blackletter "LINK", blocky 3D "RELEASE"). Each row is a CSS marquee with its own random 10–20s duration, so the bands drift against each other. Hovering a row switches it to lilac. The header enters with a translateY + skewY pop.
